text:
Riley (partnerships): Heads up: CloudMerchant sent a bulk PO batch with mixed currencies (USD + EUR) under a single PO number. Marketplace portal rejects because billing entity mismatch across lines. Customer needs seats enabled today. :sweat_smile:
Sam (finance): Oof. Do we have the PO snippet? need currency per line and billingEntity mapping.
Riley (partnerships): Snippet: 
```
<PO id=\"CM-7788\">\n  <Vendor>CLOUD-MERCHANT</Vendor>\n  <Lines>\n    <Line><SKU>CM-SEAT</SKU><Qty>100</Qty><Price currency=\"USD\">10.00</Price><BillingEntity>Redwood-US</BillingEntity></Line>\n    <Line><SKU>CM-SEA-EU</SKU><Qty>50</Qty><Price currency=\"EUR\">9.00</Price><BillingEntity>CloudMerchant-EU</BillingEntity></Line>\n  </Lines>\n</PO>
```
Priya (legal): Marketplace expects single billingEntity per PO. Mixing billing entities can imply cross-border reseller arrangements — legal implications for VAT and contract counterparty.
Omar (partner-ops): Portal error: `<error code=\"BILLING_ENTITY_INCONSISTENT\">multiple_billing_entities_in_po</error>` and it rejects the whole batch. MarketplaceBot: "Ticket MK-40221 created: billing entity mismatch in PO CM-7788. SLA 48h."
Jules (eng-integrations): Two short-term options: 1) split the PO into two separate PO payloads per billingEntity before sending (fast transform) OR 2) ask marketplace partner admin to accept multi-entity PO for this account (manual exception). Transform is easy if buyer agrees.
Zoe (customer-success): CloudMerchant says procurement exported their internal consolidated PO and won't reissue split POs. They want us to proceed without re-upload.
Sam (finance): If we split on our side we must preserve accounting traceability and not change invoice payee. Also need buyer/reseller acknowledgement that we're splitting for portal compatibility.
Priya (legal): If we programmatically split, we should attach a legal notice and keep the original PO intact in audit logs. Also need an acknowledgement email from buyer/reseller to avoid disputes.
Riley (partnerships): Proposed plan: request a one-off partner admin override for immediate provisioning + concurrently implement automatic split transform that emits two PO messages (preserving original PO id with suffixes) and logs original to S3. Attach buyer/reseller acknowledgement. Thoughts?
Jules (eng-integrations): Implement transform as middleware in the gateway: detect multiple billingEntity values -> fork payload into PO-7788-US and PO-7788-EU, add header X-Original-PO: CM-7788 and store original XML to s3://po-audit/CM-7788-original.xml. ETA for hotfix: 36 hours to staging, 72 hours to prod if approved.
Omar (partner-ops): I'll file expedited partner ticket MK-40221-ESC with the marketplace and request an admin decision while we work the transform. Marking as high priority given go-live.
MarketplaceBot: "MK-40221 status: pending partner review. Expected update in ~6h."
Sam (finance): Accounting ops: "We can accept split if both resulting POs preserve original PO number correspondence and each line invoices to the correct payee. Need buyer email acknowledging split mapping."
Zoe (customer-success): CloudMerchant agreed to send a confirmation email that Redwood may split the PO for platform compatibility and that invoices should route to the original billingEntities per line. Sending now.
Priya (legal): I'll prepare a short acknowledgement template that includes indemnity language and confirms billing mapping. If we do the transform, we should include metadata in each derived PO: <DerivedFrom>CM-7788</DerivedFrom> and an auditHash.
Riley (partnerships): Action items: Omar -> escalate MK-40221; Jules -> prototype split transform; Priya -> ack template; Sam -> confirm accounting sign-off on derived PO mapping; Zoe -> secure buyer confirmation (received). Follow-up in 4 hours or when MK updates. :white_check_mark:
